notes: ἀρχισυνάγωγος → 'ruler of the synagogue' heads on 'ruler', the word naming the referent; rule 91's query points the same way, the corpus spending 'synagogue' on συναγωγή elsewhere in this very chapter, so 'ruler' is what this lexeme's English contributes. Heading on 'synagogue' by analogy with ἀρχιερεύς → 'chief priest' remains the competing reading.
τῷ before οἴκῳ is unrepresented under rule 20, the genitive αὐτοῦ carrying 'his'.
18:17 renders the same lexeme identically and is analysed the same way, per rule 24.
